references.title: The Surprising Power of Constant Depth Algebraic Proofs
references.note: Shows strong simulations involving AC0[p]-Frege and TC0-Frege and emphasizes the difficulty of lower bounds for bounded-depth Frege systems.

references.title: Quantum Automating TC0-Frege Is LWE-Hard
references.note: Provides conditional quantum weak-automatability hardness for TC0-Frege under LWE and surveys related conditional classical hardness.

references.title: Superpolynomial Length Lower Bounds for Tree-Like Semantic Proof Systems with Bounded Line Size
references.note: Proves strong lower bounds for tree-like semantic Frege with bounded line size, not full dag-like TC0-Frege.

references.title: Hard CNF Instances for Ideal Proof Systems
references.note: Establishes CNF lower bounds for roABP-IPS and identifies full-IPS lower bounds on Boolean CNFs as a central frontier.

references.title: IPS Lower Bounds for Formulas and Sum of ROABPs
references.note: Proves lower bounds for multilinear, formula, and sum-of-ROABP IPS fragments rather than unrestricted full IPS.

references.title: Circuit Complexity, Proof Complexity, and Polynomial Identity Testing
references.note: Introduces the Ideal Proof System and relates IPS lower bounds, algebraic circuit lower bounds, and polynomial identity testing.

references.title: Depth d Frege Systems Are Not Automatable Unless P=NP
references.note: Shows NP-hardness of automating every fixed-depth Frege system, but does not literally settle unconditional weak automatability of TC0-Frege.

references.title: New Limits for Knowledge Compilation and Applications to Exact Model Counting
references.note: Provides strong DNNF and SDD representation lower bounds relevant to exact compilation attacks.

references.title: On Compiling DNNFs without Determinism
references.note: Shows that auxiliary variables followed by existential quantification can yield exponentially smaller DNNF compilations, blocking naive direct-representation arguments.

references.title: Knowledge Compilation, Width and Quantification
references.note: Studies width in OBDD and structured d-DNNF under quantification and connects bounded treewidth to tractable compilation.

references.title: Parameterized Compilation Lower Bounds for Restricted CNF-formulas
references.note: Gives unconditional parameterized DNNF lower bounds for CNFs under several structural width measures.

claim_boundary: Primary sources establish context and attack boundaries only; they do not certify truth, novelty, or completeness.
